newsitem.title: USA: Howtek settles suit with Teco for $6 mln.
newsitem.headline: Howtek settles suit with Teco for $6 mln.

text.p: Howtek Inc said Thursday that it has received $6 million from Teco Electric & Machinery Co Ltd, Teco Information Systems Co Ltd, and Relisys, a Teco subsidiary, as part of a setllement of a lawsuit filed against the companies and Herman Hsu, a Teco employee, in June, 1994.

The company said the suit stemmed from an allegation by Howtek that Taiwan-based Teco breached a contract by manufacturing certain scanners under the Teco name, instead of solely under the Howtek name.

Under the agreement, said Howtek, all existing agreements between the companies have been terminated. It also said it has released the Teco companies, Relisys and Hsu from all covenants not to compete and from any claims relating to the scanner technology involved in the case.
Neither party admitted to any breach of contract or other wrongdoing in connection with the settlement of this lawsuit, said Howtek.

Howtek designs, engineers and manufactures flatbed and drum scanners for the graphic arts and desktop publishing markets, densitometers for the life sciences market, and film digitizers for the medical imaging market.
